title: Depth First Search
description: An explicit stack drives the traversal deep before it goes wide.

steps.label: allocate graph
steps.note: The adjacency map and its four edge lists are allocated.

steps.label: call dfs
steps.note: The traversal frame receives the graph reference and the start node.

steps.label: init frontier
steps.note: The frontier starts with a single node.

steps.label: pop A
steps.note: A leaves the frontier and becomes the active node.

steps.label: visit A
steps.note: A is recorded; the visit order is now ['A'].

steps.label: queue C, B
steps.note: Neighbours of A are pushed for later exploration.

steps.label: pop B
steps.note: B leaves the frontier and becomes the active node.

steps.label: visit B
steps.note: B is recorded; the visit order is now ['A', 'B'].

steps.label: queue D
steps.note: Neighbours of B are pushed for later exploration.

steps.label: pop D
steps.note: D leaves the frontier and becomes the active node.

steps.label: visit D
steps.note: D is recorded; the visit order is now ['A', 'B', 'D'].

steps.label: pop C
steps.note: C leaves the frontier and becomes the active node.

steps.label: visit C
steps.note: C is recorded; the visit order is now ['A', 'B', 'D', 'C'].

steps.label: queue D
steps.note: Neighbours of C are pushed for later exploration.

steps.label: pop D
steps.note: D leaves the frontier and becomes the active node.

steps.label: skip D
steps.note: D was already visited — the branch is pruned.

steps.label: return order
steps.note: Every reachable node has been visited.

steps.label: print order
steps.note: Depth first order is written to stdout.
